mapper.select: SELECT w.workspace_id AS "workspaceId", wm.member_id AS "memberId", w.subject AS "subject", w.status AS "status" FROM workspace_domains wd JOIN workspaces w ON wd.workspace_id = w.workspace_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON w.workspace_id = wm.workspace_id WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domain} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0

SELECT w.workspace_id AS "workspaceId", wm.member_id AS "memberId", w.subject, w.status, wd.domain_key AS "domainKey" FROM workspace_members wm JOIN workspaces w ON wm.workspace_id = w.workspace_id JOIN workspace_domains wd ON w.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id WHERE wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND wm.status = 0
